newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa poised to correct higher after slide.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa poised to correct higher after slide.

text.p: MAY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa futures look to have reversed the slide seen earlier this week and should continue their corrective upward bounce, traders and analysts said on Wednesday.
London's benchmark May contract ended lower on Tuesday but trade buying helped to keep the market above Monday's low of 968 stg, although the close was still 20 stg down on the day at 972.
Traders called the market to open 10 stg higher than Tuesday's close, noting that the lack of a challenge to the 968 level was constructive.
Technical analysts said May had started to claw back some of its lost ground, but could still slide towards 940 if the upper range of December's trading area was broken at around 970.

Although the position was not yet in oversold territory, its 14-day relative strength index was sliding fast towards the 30-value buffer and other short-term momentum indicators were still pointing lower.
Analysts said the speed of Monday's fall suggested the spot value was likely to attempt to consolidate, although the market still had downside potential.
The London market had seen a fund-led sell-off on Monday with May diving by as much as five percent as New York opened sharply lower.
Initial resistance was pegged at 1,000, followed by 1,020. Lateral support was expected from the late January highs of around 940 basis May.
